patterns.note: Full-bleed, highly detailed illustrations serve as primary section backgrounds, often with large, expressive typography overlaid.
Hero and statistic sections feature extremely large, custom-illustrated or heavily stylized display fonts that integrate directly into the visual artwork.

A vibrant, naturalistic color palette, rich in greens, blues, and earthy tones, is used for illustrations, contrasting sharply with deep, dark background colors (dark green, black) to enhance visual pop.
The hero section transitions through multiple distinct, full-screen illustrative scenes as the user scrolls, each revealing new artwork and sometimes changing the background color.
Key statistics and content blocks are presented as large, isolated statements or card-like elements, often with a single, dominant visual or number.

technique_notes: The site employs a multi-stage, scroll-triggered hero animation system, likely using GSAP ScrollTrigger, where distinct full-bleed canvas or SVG illustrations are sequentially revealed or swapped out as the user scrolls down the page. Each stage presents a new visual narrative, often accompanied by a background color shift. The navigation bar remains sticky at the top throughout these transitions.
Large, custom-designed display typography is integrated directly into the hero and section illustrations, often appearing as if drawn or painted into the scene, enhancing the bespoke, artistic feel.
Content sections utilize a dark, often black, background to make vibrant, illustrative elements and light-colored text stand out dramatically.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, illustrative display headings (~8x body) with a playful, organic character, contrasted with more legible, medium-weight body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp for structural elements, but organic and flowing curves are dominant within the illustrations and custom typography.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with significant vertical spacing between major sections and large, isolated content blocks, creating a sense of grandeur and visual breathing room.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its deeply integrated, multi-stage illustrative hero experience. Instead of a static image or video, the entire top portion of the page transforms with rich, custom artwork and typography as the user scrolls, creating a highly immersive and narrative-driven introduction to the content.
